text:
Alex (CSM): Heads-up — Aperture's QBR is next Wed. I pulled their spend and theres a big embeddings/semantic-search spike this week, likely from a new campaign. Need a short summary and mitigation plan for the QBR.
Diego (FinOps): Looking now. Raw 7d burn +120% vs baseline. I'm running a quick forecast for next 30d.
alerts-bot: Budget alert triggered for account: aperture-inc — daily spend > $5k (3/31 09:14 UTC).
Sam (Solutions Eng): Echo — if they're hitting embeddings, check vector dimension + batching. Also ask if they switched from sparse to dense index. Might be able to cut cost 30-50% with quantized embeddings and fewer shards.
Priya (Onboarding PM): Can we book a 30m enablement for Aperture next Tue? Focus: query patterns, caching hints, and best-effort prompt templates to reduce tokens. I can own scheduling and the enablement deck.
Diego (FinOps): Quick numbers: baseline monthly forecast w/o change: $18.4k. With expected campaign -> $34.2k. With throttling + batching & switch to gpt-emb-small variant -> estimate $22.1k. So incremental risk if nothing changes is ~+86%.
Alex (CSM): Yikes. Priya — please set the enablement and ask them to share a sample workload / top queries before the session. Sam, Diego — can you provide 2-3 concrete plays we can present?
Sam (Solutions Eng): Yes. Plays: 1) Move heavy analytical queries to periodic batch embeddings and upsert vectors instead of real-time full-net queries. 2) Reduce embedding dim: try 512->256 trial. 3) Enable prefix KV caching on frequent queries.
Diego (FinOps): Add: temporary quota & alerts. Suggest we set a soft cap at current daily avg *1.2 and a hard cap at current avg *2. Also propose a short-term credit offset (CSP) for the campaign week — we can offer credits to avoid churn risk while they adopt the cost fixes.
Aperture Success Admin: We'll ask product to surface top 10 queries and a sample of 1k calls. Also confirms they launched a new "insights" page on Apr 20.
Alex (CSM): Good. For the QBR slide deck I'd like: 1) 30s summary of what's happening + delta numbers, 2) Proposed plays with estimated savings, 3) Enablement plan & owner, 4) Ask (quota change / credits / follow-up dates).
Sam (Solutions Eng): I'll draft the plays slide with estimated percent savings and simple conservatively-modeled numbers. ETA end of day.
Diego (FinOps): I'll attach the forecast numbers and a short runway calc. Quick calc snippet I used: ```
// simplified
avg_daily = 1140.5
campaign_multiplier = 2.8
monthly_forecast = avg_daily * campaign_multiplier * 30
```
Priya (Onboarding PM): Scheduled enablement invite sent for Tue 10:00 PT — invite includes request for sample logs + top queries.
Alex (CSM): Thanks. Action items: Diego -> final 30d forecast + credit recommendation (by EOD). Sam -> plays slide + savings estimates (EOD). Priya -> ensure samples + run enablement Tue. I'll assemble QBR deck and circulate draft tomorrow AM.
Aperture Success Admin: Appreciate the rapid response team. We'll prioritize the sample collection and join enablement.
Alex (CSM): If we need to triage live during the campaign, we can enable temporary throttling on route config: `POST /v1/accounts/aperture/quotas` body `{ "daily": 24000 }` (example). Will keep thread updated. :thumbsup:
Diego (FinOps): Final note — flagging renewal risk if monthly runrate stays >2x baseline for 30d. We'll model mitigations in the deck.
Alex (CSM): Copy that. Closing loop — I'll ping again with deck link. Thanks everyone. :pray:
